critique.evidence: The dark grid, cyan/coral palette, bordered panels, glowing controls, and strong result states create a cohesive, polished cyber-lab aesthetic. Desktop’s two-column card and mobile’s single-column flow have clear hierarchy. However, responsive composition is visibly compromised: on desktop the navigation bar cuts across and nearly obscures the oversized hero title, while on tablet the fixed navigation overlays the controls mid-card and its menu is clipped at the right edge. Numerous micro-labels and annotations are also extremely small, especially on mobile, weakening readability and refinement. These conspicuous overlap and typography issues prevent demo-ready polish across all three viewports.
critique.fix: Correct the header’s sticky positioning and page offsets so it never overlaps the hero or form; use a collapsed tablet navigation rather than a clipped desktop rail. Keep the hero treatment consistent across breakpoints, increase the smallest label/body sizes and line height, and slightly relax mobile panel spacing around headings and result cells.
